title: Onto cart
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：onto　|　正文 355 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 onto 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the warden kept the notice ① onto the morning of the fair at the gate, and everybody in the centre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning: the notice had been left ② onto the back of the cart, and nobody had asked a single question. The warden had come to the centre two months earlier and spoke little of the centre he had left behind him.

The register for June 1970 puts it plainer. It was done ③ onto the top of the pile, and the resident who kept the notice had fill ined it ④ onto the shoulders of his brother twice before the winter came; nothing in the centre was ever done onto the top of the pile in those days. The resident wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every month thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the notice at the far gate, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ onto the fear of the water, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ onto the floor of the hall; he was not a man who explained himself, and the centre had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1983 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was that the notice be fill ined ⑦ onto the roof of the shed, and that the names be written ⑧ onto the page of the ledger. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried onto the roof of the shed.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1986 she kept the notice ⑨ onto the morning of the fair again when nobody else would, and ⑩ onto the back of the cart, she said in 1988, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the notice in the same gate for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the centre never forgot what had been done onto the back of the cart.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 到…之上（表时间：onto the morning of the fair）
B. prep. 到…之上（表处所：onto the back of the cart）
C. prep. 到…之上（表方式／状态：onto the top of the pile）
D. prep. 到…之上（引出施动者或相关的人：be fill ined onto the shoulders of his brother）
E. prep. 到…之上（表原因：onto the fear of the water）
F. prep. 到…之上（表对象／目的：onto the floor of the hall）
G. prep. 到…之上（表工具／材料：onto the roof of the shed）
H. prep. 到…之上（表载体／处所：written onto the page of the ledger）

items.q: onto the morning of the fair
onto the back of the cart
onto the top of the pile
onto the shoulders of his brother
onto the fear of the water
onto the floor of the hall
onto the roof of the shed
onto the page of the ledger
onto the morning of the fair again
onto the back of the cart, she said

answers.why: onto 意为“到…之上”，此处引出时间 the morning of the fair（集市那天早上），说明那件小小的告示是在何时留下的。
onto 意为“到…之上”，此处引出处所 the back of the cart（车板上面），说明东西被放在何处。
onto 意为“到…之上”，此处引出方式或状态 the top of the pile（那一堆的顶上），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
onto 意为“到…之上”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 他兄弟的肩上：be fill ined onto the shoulders of his brother。
onto 意为“到…之上”，此处引出原因 the fear of the water（因为怕水），说明整件事由何而起。
onto 意为“到…之上”，此处引出对象或目的 the floor of the hall（厅里的地板上）。
onto 意为“到…之上”，此处引出工具或材料 the roof of the shed（棚屋的顶上）。
onto 意为“到…之上”，此处引出载体 the page of the ledger（账簿的页面上）：names written onto the page of the ledger。
onto 意为“到…之上”，1986 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件小小的告示，此处仍引出时间 the morning of the fair。
onto 意为“到…之上”，母亲 1988 年那句话引出的仍是那一处车板上面。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1976 年集市那天早上前后，管理员把那件小小的告示留在了大门。（onto the morning of the fair）
那件小小的告示被放在车板上面，谁也没有过问。（onto the back of the cart）
整件事是那一堆的顶上做成的，登记册上写得明白。（onto the top of the pile）
入冬之前，那件小小的告示已经由他兄弟的肩上填过两回。（be fill ined onto the shoulders of his brother）
叔叔说，整件事是由因为怕水起的。（onto the fear of the water）
他说，家里从来没有人为厅里的地板上做过这件事。（onto the floor of the hall）
answers: In 1976 the warden kept the notice onto the morning of the fair at the gate.
The notice had been left onto the back of the cart, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done onto the top of the pile, or so the register says.
The notice had been fill ined onto the shoulders of his brother twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun onto the fear of the water.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it onto the floor of the hall.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 onto 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1976 the warden kept the notice onto the morning of the fair, and nobody forgot it.
The notice had been left onto the back of the cart for three months.
The work was done onto the top of the pile, as it always was in those days.
The notice had been fill ined onto the shoulders of his brother twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the notice onto the morning of the fair again when nobody else would.
The whole centre never forgot what had been done onto the back of the cart.
